experiments.title: Breakout volume gate: require volume >= 1.5x / 2.0x (baseline gate is 1.2x)
BTC regime gate: no new entries while BTC is below its EMA20 (variants: below EMA50 / below 20d support)
ATR stop multiplier for swing market entries: 1.5 / 2.5 / 3.0 x ATR (baseline 2.0; target stays 3R of the stop distance)
Profit-protect giveback threshold: 25% / 50% / off (baseline 35% of peak profit)
Partial-profit settings: off / partial at +1.0R / at +2.0R / sell 33% (baseline: 50% at +1.5R then breakeven stop)
RSI cap on entries: skip when daily RSI >= 70 (breakout rule already caps at 80)
Extension filter threshold: max ATRs above EMA20 = 2.0 / 2.5 (baseline 3.0)
Relative-strength gate: require 30d return >= BTC's (RS vs BTC >= 0%)
Volatility cap: skip coins with daily ATR% above 8% / 6%
